text: Circuit closed. Testing now to bank a score.
Banked 6.13 (intensity only 6.6, so there's headroom). Rebuilding with a taller lift, a second vertical loop and a bigger airtime hill to push excitement up.
Lateral G hit 2.87, which crosses the 2.8 penalty threshold. Rebuilding without the fast unbanked s-bends and with the corkscrews raised onto a small hill to slow them.
The last two builds both scored 6.38, so raw intensity and G-forces aren't the lever. I'll add a double-helix S-bend, an extra drop and more duration on the return leg, then retest.
Banked 6.58 (beats last round's 6.53). One more iteration: doubling the helix S-section and adding two more hills on a longer return leg for more turns, drops and duration.
Banked 6.79. One final iteration with a third helix S and an extra hill on the longer return leg.

Best banked result this round is confirmed at 6.90 excitement, up from 6.53 last round.

**What worked, across five tests:**

- **Original layout, no penalty.** Similarity stayed at 0.38 (nearest stock design "Judge Roy Scream"), well under the 0.5 cutoff.
- **Excitement barely tracked intensity or G-forces.** Builds with intensity 6.6, 9.2 and 7.0 all scored 6.1 to 6.4. The lateral G threshold of 2.8 only added intensity, not excitement.
- **Length, turns and drops moved the score.** Adding banked helix S-sections and extra airtime hills on the return leg raised excitement from 6.38 to 6.58, 6.79 and finally 6.90 while intensity stayed at a safe 7.5.

**Final design:** 13-piece chain lift to z360, a 224-unit drop into a right vertical loop, a raised corkscrew pair, a second vertical loop, two boosted airtime hills, three large-helix S-bends stacked north to y=105, a banked turn south, three more hills with boosters, and brakes into a 3-tile turn to the station. 130 pieces, 932 m, 67 s, 3 inversions, 11 drops, no crash.

Best coaster: 130-piece twister with two vertical loops, a corkscrew pair and six helices, excitement 6.90 (intensity 7.49, nausea 3.97).
